data.public_scope: diagnostic only; selected-object DAVIS mask trajectories; every third frame, at most 32 frames, evaluated at trial playback 8 Hz

public_video.public_precision_scope: selected-object annotation correspondence, not exhaustive event precision

rendered.public_precision_scope: selected-object annotation correspondence, not exhaustive event precision

primary_ERE.public_precision_note: selected annotated-object correspondence only; predicted events on other objects are not exhaustive false positives
primary_ERE.failure_interpretation: Good source extraction does not imply appearance-invariant event matching; all six AUC values below 0.9; annotation-only subgrouping does not replace primary labels/gates

primary_STA.scope: 32 PNG keyframes, no captions, checksum verification, zero-order-hold raster decoder; no actual generative model

STA_supplements.same_classifier_scope: Same classifier as baselines on STA features; primary adoption test remains unchanged

mse.scope: predeclared STA feature classifier and same-input baselines; same classifier family, post-hoc paired CI, no retuning

mae.scope: predeclared STA feature classifier and same-input baselines; same classifier family, post-hoc paired CI, no retuning

mse_and_mae.scope: predeclared STA feature classifier and same-input baselines; same classifier family, post-hoc paired CI, no retuning

has_missing.scope: post-hoc target-alignment diagnostic; original primary labels/gate retained; extra-only events are outside an omission-only GFR target

extra_only.scope: post-hoc target-alignment diagnostic; original primary labels/gate retained; extra-only events are outside an omission-only GFR target

STA_supplements.interpretation: Predeclared fault-only STA features + fixed classifier discriminate the known intervention labels well. This does not fix the primary rule or validate normal robustness, calibrated semantic error rates, or real decoder causal attribution.

real_reconstruction_diagnostics.ERE_null_handling: Source with fewer than two inferred events abstains; null is not zero
real_reconstruction_diagnostics.adapter_regression: 24 fps index 16 first applies at 8 Hz sample 6, not sample 5; offset 1/12 seconds

primary_and_supplement_integrity.note: All scored RGB hashes were additionally checked when each formal observer loaded its input.

transport_replay.scope: independent byte/checksum/PNG decoding and zero-order hold replay matches every stored TX/RX RGB SHA; no metric scores read

exact_memoization_probe.scope: CPU scoring of existing development RGB observations only

research_status.novelty_review_scope: limited primary-paper, author-code and official-documentation review; not an exhaustive novelty proof
research_status.next_revalidation_requires: new heldout source and scene families after any metric or decision-rule changes
